headline: Human cloning bill set aside by Senate Judiciary Committee
snippet: Senate committee sets aside HB380 after initially approving it.

headline: Alabama House votes to make human cloning a felony
snippet: House passes 71-4 with 22 abstentions. Amended to permit organ cloning.

headline: This Alabama state representative wants to outlaw human cloning
snippet: Rep. Rigsby admits no cloning happening but says 'prospect challenges us to make a firm stand.'
